title: Educational Technology
topics: Meaning and scope of educational technology

items.q: Which of the following best describes Barrier to technology use?
o: any obstacle such as poor power supply or lack of skill that keeps a teacher from using media
the arrangement of learners, content, media and evaluation into one working whole
the transfer of a message from a source through a channel to a receiver who responds
a machine that shows one small transparent photograph at a time on a screen
items.s: Barrier to technology use: any obstacle such as poor power supply or lack of skill that keeps a teacher from using media. The other options describe Slide projector, Communication, Instructional system.

items.q: Which term is described by “the actual specimen or article brought into the class for learners to handle”?
o: Cartoon
Map
Chart
Real object
items.s: Real object is the actual specimen or article brought into the class for learners to handle.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Direct purposeful experience?
o: a display surface on which notices and pupils' work are pinned for a period
the treatment of teaching as a set of related parts whose workings are planned together
learning gained by handling the real thing in a real setting
the record of all equipment held, with its quantity and condition
items.s: Direct purposeful experience: learning gained by handling the real thing in a real setting. The other options describe Bulletin board, System approach, Inventory.

items.q: The statement “a statement of what the learner will be able to do, stated in observable terms” describes which of the following?
o: Task analysis
Behavioural objective
Set induction
Lesson plan
items.s: Behavioural objective is a statement of what the learner will be able to do, stated in observable terms.

items.q: Which term is described by “the reusable writing surface on which a teacher develops a lesson before the class”?

Flip chart

Interactive whiteboard
items.s: Chalkboard is the reusable writing surface on which a teacher develops a lesson before the class.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Storage.

a room of booths with headsets where learners practise listening and speaking
a three dimensional copy of an object made to a convenient scale
a picture made by the action of light on a treated surface and kept for reference
items.s: Storage: the safe and orderly keeping of materials when they are not in use. The other options describe Language laboratory, Photograph, Model.

items.q: Graph may be defined as
o: a drawing in which quantities are shown by lines or bars against two scales
the arrangement of learning resources from direct firsthand encounter at the base to verbal symbols at the top
any substance or object found in the environment that can be turned into a teaching aid
the making of a substitute teaching aid from cheap local materials
items.s: Graph: a drawing in which quantities are shown by lines or bars against two scales. The other options describe Local material, Cone of experience, Improvisation.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Instructional technology?
o: the branch concerned with the selection and use of media and methods for teaching
the instruction given to serving teachers so that they can acquire new skills
the use of tools and machines as aids within an otherwise unchanged classroom
the routine embedding of devices into ordinary lessons rather than occasional demonstration
items.s: Instructional technology: the branch concerned with the selection and use of media and methods for teaching. The other options describe In-service training, Technology integration, Technology in education.
items.t: Meaning and scope of educational technology

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Educational technology?

the orderly planning of a unit of teaching from analysis of need to trial and revision
any obstacle such as poor power supply or lack of skill that keeps a teacher from using media
items.s: Educational technology: the systematic application of knowledge about learning to the design and delivery of instruction. The other options describe Podcast, Barrier to technology use, Instructional design.
